title: Identity & NHI
subtitle: SSO, SCIM, identity inventory, the NHI lifecycle, the WIF graph and privileged login — observed, governed and audited.

seam.body: {{what}} is a declared contract — the backend endpoint is not live yet, so there is nothing to show. This panel will populate the moment it lands; it never fabricates data.

assurance.stepUpBody: {{action}} requires {{required}}. Your session is {{current}}. Authenticate with a hardware security key to continue.
assurance.unsupported: This browser does not support WebAuthn. A platform that supports phishing-resistant authenticators is required for privileged actions.
assurance.failed: Step-up did not complete. The action stays denied.

actions.wif: Viewing the Workload Identity Federation graph

assurance.unenrolled: No passkey is registered for your account yet. Register a hardware security key in the Privileged login tab first, then retry the step-up.

references.note: Standards this panel reflects. The panel observes and verifies; it does not claim certification.

sso.title: Single sign-on (OIDC / SAML)
sso.description: Federated login is implemented in the business build and configured by environment at boot. This panel documents the configuration, checks the exact redirect URI and surfaces the connection state — it does not write the configuration.
sso.notConfiguredHint: No identity provider is configured, so federation requests return 501. Set the environment keys below and restart the engine to enable SSO.
sso.redirectCheckHint: Paste the redirect/ACS URI configured in your identity provider. It must match the value above exactly (RFC 9700).
sso.redirectMatch: Exact match — this redirect URI is valid.
sso.redirectMismatch: Does not match exactly. The IdP must use the redirect URI above, character-for-character.
sso.envNote: Configuration is read once at boot from the environment; there is no configuration write API. Secrets are never read back.

scim.title: SCIM 2.0 provisioning
scim.description: Inbound provisioning of users and groups. Read-only status of the service provider, the synchronized users, and the leaver evidence.
scim.bearerNote: Authentication is a tenant-bound bearer token. The token value is never displayed — only its reference.
scim.noUsersHint: Once your IdP provisions users over SCIM they appear here. A disabled (mover/leaver) user shows as inactive.
scim.groupsSupported: Group provisioning is supported inbound (groups and memberships). Mapping a directory group to a role stays operator-only, in Identity → Groups.
scim.noLeaverHint: When a SCIM leaver (delete / prov:delete) is processed, the backend revokes the user's sessions and tokens and records it here.

console.title: Claude console posture
console.description: What the Anthropic Admin API does — and does not — let us verify about your org's identity posture. Surfaced honestly, never as a complete roster.
console.noFindingsHint: The claude-console connector emits a structural posture finding when configured.
console.blindSpotTitle: Admin-API blind spot (structural — not a misconfiguration)

blindSpots.ssoEnforcement: SSO enforcement state is not exposed by the Admin API (unknown-by-API).
blindSpots.scimProvisioning: SCIM provisioning state is not exposed by the Admin API (unknown-by-API).
blindSpots.members: Organization members ARE listable via the Admin API.
blindSpots.ssoJit: SSO / JIT is a Team-plan-and-above capability.
blindSpots.continuousAudit: Continuous audit is the Compliance Activity Feed, not a pollable API (the 180-day CSV is an owner-only Console download).

roster.label: Non-human and human identities
roster.convergenceNote: This identity converges by its external ID — the same id the observed side uses — so the access map can diff what it is PERMITTED versus what it is OBSERVED doing.

forbidden.title: Not authorized
forbidden.description: Your role does not have permission to read the NHI lifecycle.

posture.title: Lifecycle posture
posture.description: Tenant-wide staleness, enforcement, ownership and criticality posture.

table.title: Governed non-human identities
table.description: Rotation posture, enforcement, accountable humans and offboarding state. Select an identity for its event trail and actions.
table.truncated_one: Showing the first {{count}} identity; more match this filter than are listed. Narrow the filters to see the rest.
table.truncated_other: Showing the first {{count}} identities; more match this filter than are listed. Narrow the filters to see the rest.

empty.title: No lifecycle records
empty.description: Run a confirmed sweep to register roster NHIs and materialize their lifecycle posture.

detail.description: Current lifecycle state and append-only governance trail.

events.title: Append-only event trail
events.description: Lifecycle changes and enforcement transitions recorded by the backend.

critical.twoAccountsAal3: This CRITICAL action requires approval from two distinct user accounts, each over an AAL3 session, before it can run. The engine enforces distinct ACCOUNTS: it cannot prove that two accounts are two different people. Both conditions follow the live risk tier, which an approval policy can lower.
critical.breakGlassPossible: Nothing runs until two distinct user accounts approve it, each over a hardware-verified session. An active emergency break-glass grant can authorize it instead — that use is recorded and reviewed afterwards. Both conditions follow the live risk tier, which an approval policy can lower.
critical.noBreakGlass: Nothing runs until two distinct user accounts approve it, each over a hardware-verified session. Break-glass cannot authorize this one: there is no emergency path around the second approver. Both conditions follow the live risk tier, which an approval policy can lower.

ownership.title: Assign human ownership
ownership.description: Set the accountable owner and sponsor using roster identity references.
ownership.humanOnly: Owner and sponsor must both resolve to human identities in the roster.
ownership.noChanges: Change the owner or sponsor before saving.
ownership.cannotClear: Owner and sponsor references cannot be cleared here. Assign another human identity instead.

policy.title: Edit rotation policy
policy.description: Set credential criticality, rotation window, target and last-known rotation.
policy.enforcementWarning: Saving this policy can indirectly change enforcement: criticality controls whether staleness alerts or blocks, and a CRITICAL stale credential can be blocked on the next sweep.
policy.maxAgeHint: Use zero to inherit the default for the selected criticality.
policy.partialUpdateNote: Leaving a field blank or at zero keeps its current value — these settings can be changed but not cleared, so a rotation window or target already set stays until you replace it.

rotate.title: Request credential rotation
rotate.description: Open the governed CRITICAL rotation request.
rotate.credentialWarning: Copy and store this credential securely now. It is shown once, is not persisted by Olivares AI, and cannot be recovered after you close this dialog.

offboard.title: Soft-delete this NHI
offboard.description: Open the HIGH-risk, single-approver offboarding request.
offboard.warning: This reversible step blocks the NHI and its bound agents, then opens a recovery window. It does not require AAL3.

finalize.title: Finalize offboarding
finalize.description: Permanently revoke a previously soft-deleted NHI.
finalize.irreversible: Finalization is irreversible. Break-glass does not apply here; the second distinct user account and AAL3 requirements cannot be bypassed.

restore.title: Restore soft-deleted NHI
restore.description: Reverse the soft-delete within its recovery window. This admin action deliberately has no dual-control gate.

sweep.title: Run lifecycle sweep
sweep.description: Recompute staleness, ownership and enforcement for this tenant.
sweep.warning: This sweep is idempotent but mutating. It can move identities to blocked enforcement and deny their governed actions.

result.title: Governed request status
result.pending: The request is pending approval; no actuation has occurred yet.
result.rejected: The governed request was rejected; no actuation occurred.
result.expired: The governed request expired; submit a new request if it is still needed.
result.noGate: No approval gate is configured, so the action remains denied.
result.unavailable: Approval was granted, but this source has no automated actuator. Follow the provider-specific manual procedure.
result.breakGlass: The action completed through the audited emergency path.
result.received: The backend returned a governed request state.

errors.mutation: The lifecycle action could not be completed. Review the request and try again.
errors.forbidden: Not authorized: your role does not permit this lifecycle action.
errors.humanOwnerRequired: Owner and sponsor must be human identities from the roster; a non-human identity cannot hold either role.
errors.softDeleteRequired: Finalization requires a prior soft-delete. Offboard the NHI first, then finalize it after the recovery decision.

gate.rejected: A reviewer rejected this request. It was not a permission problem — ask the reviewer, or open a new request with the missing context.
gate.expired: The approval for this request lapsed before it was carried out. Open a new request; the previous decision no longer authorizes anything.
gate.no_gate: No approval gate is wired, so this action cannot be governed and is refused. An operator must configure governance before it can run.

mcp.title: MCP authorization
mcp.description: Whether each MCP server's OAuth token binding was verified. Defensive posture only — the panel never proxies or replays a token.
mcp.noFindingsHint: When an OAuth-protected MCP server is discovered, its token-binding posture is recorded here.
mcp.prmDescription: How an OAuth-protected MCP server binds a token to one concrete resource — so a token minted for one server cannot be replayed at another.

prm.title: Protected Resource Metadata
prm.body: The server advertises its authorization servers at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource (RFC 9728).

asDiscovery.title: Authorization server discovery
asDiscovery.body: The advertised authorization server's metadata is fetched (RFC 8414).

pkce.title: PKCE S256
pkce.body: The authorization code flow uses a S256 challenge (RFC 7636) — never plain.

resourceBound.title: Resource-bound token
resourceBound.body: The resource indicator (RFC 8707) is the canonical server URI, so the token's audience is one concrete server.

introspect.title: Read-only introspection
introspect.body: The token binding is verified by read-only introspection; the panel never calls tools or proxies the token.

mcp.noPassthrough: Token passthrough is prohibited by design: the panel observes and introspects, it never forwards or replays an MCP token.

wif.gatedNote: The Workload Identity Federation graph is a privileged, audited view; it requires hardware step-up.
wif.consoleOnly: Workload identity federation objects (issuers, rules, service accounts) are managed only in the Anthropic Console. This panel visualises and lints them — it never creates or edits them.
wif.graphDescription: Federation issuer → rule → service account → OAuth scope, with the linter flagging over-broad boundaries.
wif.emptyHint: No Workload Identity Federation issuers, rules or service accounts are configured for this organization. Declare federation in the Anthropic Console to govern non-human access without static keys.
wif.lintNoFindings: No lint findings — the federation graph looks well-scoped.
wif.lintRulesTitle: The linter is ready. When the graph loads it applies these rules:

cel-over-broad.title: Over-broad federation rule
cel-over-broad.detail: This rule's match is too permissive. CEL conditions are security boundaries — narrow subject_prefix, audience, claims or the CEL condition.
cel-over-broad.rule: flags rules whose subject / audience / claims / CEL match is too permissive.

key-shadow.title: Static key shadows federation
key-shadow.detail: {{var}} is present — a static Anthropic key takes precedence and silently disables Workload Identity Federation, so a "keyless" org keeps using the long-lived key.
key-shadow.recommendation: Run `ant auth status` to confirm the active credential, then unset the static key to actually use federation.
key-shadow.rule: flags a static ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / AUTH_TOKEN that shadows WIF.

token-lifetime.title: Token lifetime concern
token-lifetime.detail: token_lifetime_seconds = {{lifetime}}. Keep it well under the {{max}}s maximum and within the supported band — shorter tokens shrink the blast radius.
token-lifetime.rule: flags token_lifetime_seconds outside 60–86400s, or close to the 24h maximum.

scope-over-broad.title: Over-broad OAuth scope
scope-over-broad.detail: Scope {{scope}} grants beyond a single workspace. Prefer workspace:developer unless org-wide management is genuinely required.
scope-over-broad.rule: flags org:manage_tunnels or unrecognised scopes; prefers least privilege.

jwks-insecure.title: Inline JWKS does not rotate
jwks-insecure.detail: This rule pins an inline JWKS ({{mode}}). Prefer discovery so the issuer's keys can rotate.
jwks-insecure.rule: flags inline JWKS that cannot rotate.

drift.title: Federation drift
drift.detail: This object diverges from the governed federation ({{reason}}). Reconcile the declared rules with the live Anthropic configuration.
drift.rule: flags declared-vs-actual drift: an undeclared (ungoverned) live rule, a declared rule missing live, or an orphan rule/issuer.

recon.declaredOnly: Showing the declared federation. Configure an org:admin OAuth token to reconcile against the live Anthropic configuration.
recon.reconciled: Reconciled with the live configuration at {{at}}.
recon.unavailable: Live reconciliation is unavailable — showing the declared baseline. Check the org:admin OAuth token.

ek.title: External keys (CMEK)
ek.description: Customer-managed encryption keys referenced by your workspaces. Posture only — never the key material.

residency.title: Workspace residency
residency.description: Data-residency and CMEK binding per workspace. The home region and a referenced CMEK are immutable.

tls.title: Panel TLS (cert-manager)
tls.description: The panel's own TLS posture: issuer, expiry, rotation and chain.

crypto.title: Crypto agility / PQC inventory
crypto.description: Classic versus post-quantum algorithms across the identity estate, and which slots can be rotated to PQC (NIST SP 800-57 r6).

unavailable.fallback: This posture could not be read on this deployment.

login.statusDescription: The authenticator assurance level of your current session. Sensitive views require a hardware step-up.
login.targetStandardsNote: AAL3 (NIST SP 800-63B-4) and PIV/CAC (FIPS 201-3) are the target standards for privileged login. The panel reflects what the backend enforces; it claims no certification.
login.passkeyDescription: Enrol a hardware security key or platform authenticator (WebAuthn / FIDO2) for phishing-resistant privileged login.
login.unsupported: This browser does not support WebAuthn.
login.pivDescription: X.509 client-certificate login with cert-to-role mapping and OCSP revocation, read from the mTLS connection.
login.pivNote: Chain and OCSP verification are performed by the backend; the panel reflects the result.
login.pivNotConfigured: PIV/CAC is not configured on this deployment. An operator enables it by setting OLIVARES_PIV_CONFIG (agency CA, cert-to-role map) on the engine.

passkeys.title: Registered passkeys
passkeys.description: Manage your FIDO2/WebAuthn authenticators. Each passkey provides phishing-resistant hardware-bound login.
passkeys.registerHint: Give your passkey a name so you can identify it later.
passkeys.registerFailed: Registration failed. Your browser may not support WebAuthn or the ceremony was cancelled.
passkeys.unsupported: This browser does not support WebAuthn/FIDO2.
passkeys.noneHint: Register a passkey to enable phishing-resistant hardware-bound login (AAL3).
passkeys.deleteBody: Delete the passkey "{{name}}"? This is permanent. You will need another registered passkey to maintain AAL3 access.
passkeys.lastCredential: Cannot delete your only passkey. Register another one first.
passkeys.stepUpRequired: Deleting a passkey requires a fresh AAL3 session. Complete a step-up authentication first.

cryptoInventory.title: No cryptographic assets inventoried
cryptoInventory.description: This build declares the TLS and post-quantum posture contract without serving it; a pending-contract notice replaces this panel until it answers.

externalKeys.title: No external key references reported yet
externalKeys.description: No customer-managed encryption keys were reported for this organization. The inventory was read successfully — this is a real zero, not a missing backend.

nhiRoster.title: No human or non-human identities yet
nhiRoster.description: After a directory source is configured, resync the identity roster to populate human and non-human identities with their external IDs.
